method: Per-site percentiles of rolling 72 h and 120 h rain; level = higher of the two (P95 watch, P99 warning, P99.9 danger). Rain-only warning, not a landslide probability.
people_source: WorldPop 2025 constrained 100 m (CC BY 4.0); OpenStreetMap had no buildings mapped here (14/11/2026)
buildings_source: Google Open Buildings v3 (CC BY-4.0 / ODbL), confidence >= 0.7; Microsoft Building Footprints and OpenStreetMap had none here
footprint_source: Team dataset gpu-training-kit, Làng Nủ 10/9/2024 debris flow, agent-digitised (not expert-validated)
